verdict.rationale: Netlify is a hosting platform with AI features (AI Gateway, dashboard AI agents), so an opt-out from AI model training is a fair question to ask. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a no-training policy, or any data-use controls for AI. The 'projects stay private until published' setting controls deploy visibility, not AI training, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
